questions.prompt: Tell me about the last gift you chose for another person.
How do you decide what to do when you have a free weekend?
Which part of your work or studies do you find most rewarding?
Talk about an occasion when something you wanted took longer than expected. Include what you were waiting for, how you spent the waiting time, and your reaction when it finally happened.
questions.notes: 依据等待话题自制的完整练习卡，不声称原题措辞。

questions.prompt: Tell a story about a sports competitor you respect. Mention how you learned about them, a challenge or achievement, and what you personally admire.
In what ways might instant services affect the patience people show in everyday life?
What role should organised sport have in a school education, and why?

Community gardens offer city residents a place to grow food and meet their neighbours. By sharing tools and exchanging advice, participants can learn practical skills while making better use of small urban spaces.
Listen to the sentence and repeat it after the recording.
questions.stimulus_text: Students can collect their project materials from the library tomorrow.
questions.notes: 需宿主从隐藏文本生成真实语音或提供音频；模考首答前不显示句子。

questions.prompt: Your study group wants to meet this evening, but you have already agreed to help at a campus event. Explain the conflict to your classmates and suggest a practical alternative.
questions.notes: 题目内容为原创；按正式流程还需听到情境描述音频。

questions.prompt: Listen to a three-person discussion about travelling to campus and summarise the speakers’ main ideas.
questions.stimulus_text: Speaker A prefers the bus because it is inexpensive. Speaker B cycles for exercise but finds rainy days difficult. Speaker C suggests a shared timetable so students can coordinate rides when buses are infrequent.
questions.notes: 这是素材草案，尚无多人音频；不可直接称为完整听力模考。

questions.prompt: A repair shop has kept your bicycle longer than promised, and you need it for work. Explain your situation politely and ask what they can do to help.
questions.notes: 原创情境；Core 与 Academic 准备时限不同，正式流程需要音频。

questions.prompt: Listen carefully, then repeat the sentence you hear.
questions.stimulus_text: The science club meets in the main building every Thursday.
questions.notes: 应播放语音而非把句子作为考生阅读材料。

questions.prompt: Describe a place where you work or study effectively. What makes it suitable for you?
Some learners prefer working with background noise. How does your own experience compare with that preference?
What technology do you use when you study?
